description:
Powerful Motor & Long Battery Life:
500W brushless motor allows for speed reach to 19 MPH and climb slopes up to 10-15°. Maximum driving range of 22 miles under certain conditions and a maximum load of 330 lbs. (The above data may vary depending on riding conditions, rider weight, climate, and proper maintenance)

Smart App:
Connect APP via Bluetooth, you can switch modes as well as keeps track of mileage and speed, more convenient and user friendly! Via the app open or lock the sport scooters. In lock mode, the wheels don't turn even if the scooter is powered on,which definitely adds an extra layer of security on top of just a physical lock.

Upgrade Performance:
This adult electric scooter equipped with 10-inch honeycomb solid tires and rear dual shock absorbers provide max comfort, even on rough surfaces or speed bumps. Turn signals and “Electronic Brake+Disc Brake” Technology for your safety.

User-Friendly Design:
With 3 speed modes, you can switch between Eco, Standard and Sport modes. ECO mode is suitable for chill riding if you’re not in a rush. Comes with a bell to let walkers or slow bike riders you're coming up to pass them!

Foldable & Portable:
The scooter can be folded into a very compact size of "43.3*20.1*21.3 inches", which makes it great for storing and easier to carry. It adopts a simple and lightweight(35.3 LBS) design, making it effortless to hold.
